title: Blocking and unblocking users
summary: Explains how to block and unblock users: block via a user’s contact card → More options → Block user (then confirm); unblock via contacts/privacy settings → Unblock (then confirm). Covers effects: blocks payment requests, prevents sending payments, and hides activity from suggestions/search, plus tips to block and report abusive/fraudulent users.
